children: Vodafone Idea is showcasing AI powered consumer, enterprise and social impact solutions at India Mobile Congress 2026, spanning intelligent customer service, connected mobility, mining, cybersecurity, agriculture and education

Vodafone Idea (Vi) is showcasing a range of AI-powered innovations and intelligent connectivity solutions at India Mobile Congress (IMC) 2026 under the theme ‘Boundless Intelligence’ and the tagline ‘Sovereign by Design’.

The showcase highlights how AI, connectivity and human ingenuity can come together to simplify customer experiences, support enterprises and enable connected industries while addressing India's diverse requirements.

“The next evolution of connectivity is intelligence. At Vi, we are harnessing AI to make experiences simpler, more intuitive and meaningful, from how customers interact with us to how connectivity can transform mobility, businesses and everyday life,” said Abhijit Kishore, CEO, Vodafone Idea.

Vi is showcasing a personal AI assistant designed to interact with customers in their preferred language. The company is also demonstrating AI-powered solutions across mining, enterprise workflows, connected mobility, agriculture and education.

Vi is showcasing an AI-powered personal assistant aimed at simplifying everyday communication and task management. The assistant moves beyond traditional app based interfaces and is designed to manage a wide range of voice calls received by Vi customers.
The company is also demonstrating a zero-touch, voice-based AI customer service solution designed to simplify support interactions and make digital journeys more accessible.

For the mining sector, Vi is demonstrating a solution combining private networks, edge computing, AI analytics and connected wearables. The system uses real-time data and operational intelligence to create safer and more responsive mining environments.

In connected mobility, Vi is showcasing platforms and partnerships aimed at supporting software-defined, AI-enabled, and safer vehicles. The demonstration covers eCall, advanced driver assistance systems (ADAS), vehicle-to-everything (V2X) connectivity, in-cabin infotainment and voice control, along with personalised navigation and commerce based on user consent.

The company is also demonstrating how its ReadyForNext digital advisory platform uses AI-powered insights, interactive tools and intelligent assistance to help micro, small and medium enterprises identify market opportunities and accelerate digital transformation.

Vi is further showcasing an AI-led security operations centre designed to provide managed threat detection and response as a service. The system combines AI based threat detection, advanced analytics and automation with cybersecurity technologies to support faster risk detection, investigation and mitigation.

Another demonstration focuses on enterprise agentic and assistive AI, bringing together Vi's people, data, models, agents and enterprise systems. The agentic AI is designed to manage end-to-end processes within defined limits and with human oversight, while assistive AI provides intelligent support for consumers, citizens, MSMEs and employees.

Vi said the platform uses sovereign capabilities, including real-time Indian language translation and in-country data processing. The company also said its AI applications have reduced interaction complaints, enabled call containment through Dynamic IVR and reduced site energy consumption in FY26.
Vi is demonstrating an AI-based solution for agriculture that combines Internet of Things (IoT), machine learning, satellite imagery and big data to provide actionable insights to farmers.

The company is also showcasing an AI-powered educational experience developed by the Vodafone Foundation and Moinee Impact Foundation, inspired by the global ‘Pedagogy of Wonder’ approach. The platform enables children to turn their ideas into stories, illustrations, audio content, and books.
